intro: A Skilled Worker dependant visa lets your partner and children join you in the UK. We prepare each Skilled Worker dependant visa application so the relationship and finances are clearly shown.
cardText: Partners and children joining a Skilled Worker.

checklist.hint: Married, civil partners, or 2 years living together

purposesTitle: Who can apply as a dependant

purposes.title: Partners
purposes.text: Husbands, wives, civil and unmarried partners.

purposes.title: Children
purposes.text: Under 18, or already in the UK as your dependant.

notCovered: Not enough evidence of the relationship

documentsTable.details: Marriage or civil partnership certificate, or 2 years’ cohabitation evidence.
Bank statements, unless your sponsor certifies maintenance.

rules.title: Care workers
rules.text: Care workers and senior care workers who applied after 11 March 2024 can’t bring dependants.

rules.title: Maintenance
rules.text: You may need to show funds for each family member, held for 28 days, unless your employer certifies maintenance on your CoS.

rules.title: Settlement together
rules.text: Dependants can usually apply for settlement with you.

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Skilled Worker dependant visa requirements
sections.text: Your partner must be your husband, wife or civil partner, or have lived with you for at least 2 years. Children must be under 18 when they first apply. You must show you can support them, unless your employer certifies maintenance.

faqs.q: Can my partner work on a Skilled Worker dependant visa?
faqs.a: Yes, partners can usually work in almost any job.
Not if they applied after 11 March 2024.

faqs.q: Can my children study in the UK?
